info.description: Free-form tag on a Post. Created on the fly at post time. Server-side normalization keeps `name` lowercase-trimmed so dedupe works.

slug.description: Derived from the normalized name by the tag.create rule in src/index.ts when the client omits it. Not schema-required because input validation runs before that rule can inject it — REST clients send only `name`. Every persisted row still gets a slug.
